confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not live listings. Food anchors are more certain than accommodation, and bar prices are less certain. The FX observation could not be verified from rba.gov.au in this session, so fx is null. Search results only showed a third-party republication of 0.6979 USD per AUD for 2026-10-09, which is unverified and was not used. Re-run the RBA F11.1 lookup before using FX.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional Southeast Asia basis, benchmarked against mid-tier urban SEA pricing in Malaysia and similar Southeast Asian capitals. Drink prices use a beer-based relationship where direct knowledge is weak: cocktails and wine are estimated at roughly 3x and 2.8x the beer anchor, respectively.
